page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head and page number at the top; catchword at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: brevi aliqvam earum ad te mitere non desinam, qvam exactissime exaratam. De Anno Christi, nempe 1542. si recte qvod scripsisti legi, vel 1592. penultima namqve hujus numeri figura non satis bene mihi perspicua fuit, licet priori potius modo qvam secundo exaratam fuisse exi-stimem, qvo qvidem anno tibi persvades Pentateuchum meum fuisse scriptum, annotaverit scriba se id præstitisse anno nongentesimo & vigesimo regni Ismaëli-tarum, non facile tibi assentior: hoc e-nim mihi certo constat, annum servato-ris nostri 1622. qvo ipse in Perside eram, anno Ismaëlitarum 1031. majori ex par-te respondisse, qvemadmodum etiam, ut ex literis ad me Constantinopoli da-tis postqvam Romam reversus fui, col-legi, ejusdem servatoris annum 1627. Muhammedanorum Hegiræ anno 1027. fere prorsus respondere: qvod si accura-te perpendamus, nec non Ismaëlitarum annum lunarem esse undecim circiter diebus minorem nostro, qvi solaris est, transactos annos retrorsum supputando,

page.notes: The line break after "annum" in "annum servato-ris" appears to have no visible space in the scan; I have read it as two words. Long s has been rendered as s throughout. Printed spellings such as qvod, qvam and qvi are kept as printed. The small dots scattered in the margins and the stains at the bottom are not text and are omitted.
